name: OpenSMM Protocol
description: Order social media growth services (followers, views, reactions) from AI agents: open, provider-neutral protocol with a reference gateway for catalog search, quotes, idempotent orders, provider-node registration and x402 payments. Install: `git clone https://github.com/opensmm-protocol/mcp-server && cd mcp-server && npm ci && npm run gateway` · [Docs](https://opensmm.dev/llms.txt)
